Attached: 1 image

Grok has published the first seven minutes of an Odyssey-based film project titled Odyssey, presented as the opening episode of a new series.

The creation was developed in partnership with Wonder Studios and director Dev Walker.

This follows previous statements regarding plans for an AI-generated historical adaptation of the classic epic.
